message: No detected input validation: The code performs no schema, dtype, or value-range checks on incoming data; data is consumed directly from numpy arrays without any defensive validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is generated synthetically (XorExperiment) or loaded from local files via pickle without any remote-source fetching, checksum verification, or authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training data during preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code restores model weights from a hardcoded local checkpoint path ('/tmp/senn.ckpt') using tf.train.Saver without any hash check, signature verification, or other integrity validation.

No detected label distribution validation: The code uses StratifiedKFold for splitting which preserves class proportions, but there is no explicit check or assertion on label distribution or class balance before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop or related code.

No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is standard AdamOptimizer with no DP-SGD noise injection, clipping mechanisms, or privacy accounting from TensorFlow Privacy or any equivalent library.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected input sanitization: No input validation or sanitization is performed on incoming data before it is passed to the model; inputs are used directly as numpy arrays without shape, range, or type checks.
No detected output bounds checks: The inference path (predict, explain, loss functions) returns raw model outputs without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it uses a Self-Explaining Neural Network (SENN) on tabular/image data, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable.
